408395309.note: Opale is controlled by Olivier Leflaive Frères (139077 of 139079 shares in 2019). The 2006 schedule names AH150/151 and AI137/138, not current AH182. AH151 is now recorded to Pousse d’Or; historical ownership remains separate from current farming.

411189830.name: Domaine Fontaine-Gagnard
411189830.note: The official registry and four company filings identify the viticultural company Domaine Fontaine-Gagnard. Selected formation, contribution and capital filings give no qualifying AE133 schedule or parcel-specific current farming evidence.

420474645.name: Domaine Heitz-Lochardet
420474645.note: The official registry and five company filings identify Domaine Heitz-Lochardet. The 2021 property contribution concerns other communes; the 2024 contribution transfers company shares to Faciens Vinum. No qualifying current AH16 schedule found.

480400407.name: Domaine de la Pousse d’Or
480400407.note: Four selected filings concern formation, transformation, property contribution and merger; no qualifying AH151 schedule found. Existing reviewed Pousse d’Or link is reused unchanged. Opale’s 2006 AH151 ownership recital remains external historical context.

519806384.name: Domaine Leflaive

751761933.name: Domaine d’Eugénie

778232892.name: Domaine des Comtes Lafon

778245316.name: Domaine Leflaive
